lines.quote: Designed phased-array beamforming algorithms for Vireo's marine navigation radar product family. Implemented adaptive beamforming (minimum variance distortionless response) for a 16-element linear array, reducing sea-clutter false alarm rates by approximately 14 dB in rough-sea conditions.

Implemented an extended Kalman filter for multi-target tracking on a TI C6678 DSP, processing radar returns from Vireo's marine array in real time. The tracker maintains up to 64 simultaneous tracks at a 20 Hz update rate. Wrote the core tracking loop and the data association logic in C++.

Conducted RF front-end characterisation across the X-band operating range: antenna radiation pattern measurements using the company's planar near-field scanner, cable and connector loss verification with a Rohde & Schwarz ZVA24 vector network analyser, and noise figure measurements at the LNA input.
